## Teaching Philosophy

I am passionate about helping students develop statistical thinking and the confidence to apply quantitative methods to real-world problems. My teaching emphasizes conceptual understanding, reproducible data analysis, effective communication, and the practical application of statistics in biomedical and health research.

I particularly enjoy helping students move from a statistical question to a defensible analysis using **R** and modern statistical tools.

---

## Teaching Experience

### Instructor of Record — Introduction to Statistics (MATH 1350)

**Department of Mathematics and Statistics, University of New Mexico**

**Semesters:** Fall 2023 · Spring 2024 · Fall 2024 · Spring 2025 · Summer 2025

As instructor of record, I independently taught five semesters of Introduction to Statistics, designing course materials, assessing student learning, and providing individualized academic support.

The course covered:

- Data collection
- Exploratory data analysis
- Probability
- Statistical inference
- Applied statistical reasoning using real-world examples

---

### Applied Statistical Computing

I incorporated **R-based data analysis** into statistics instruction, helping students translate statistical concepts into reproducible analytical workflows.

## Mentoring & Inclusive Teaching

I am committed to creating supportive learning environments that encourage curiosity, confidence, and inclusive participation in quantitative disciplines. My mentoring experience includes working with students from diverse academic backgrounds and supporting underrepresented students in mathematics, statistics, and research.

---

## Professional Development

My teaching development includes formal training through the **Graduate Teaching Scholar Program** at the University of New Mexico and participation in the **NSF-supported Teaching Statistical Thinking Workshop** at Curry College.

These experiences strengthened my interest in evidence-based teaching, statistical reasoning, and effective communication of quantitative concepts.
